title: SyntheMol: generated antibiotic candidates against Acinetobacter baumannii
summary: The generative model proposed about 25,000 candidates in under nine hours from more than 130,000 synthesis building blocks; of 58 synthesized, six killed a drug-resistant A. baumannii strain and two were not toxic in mice. Mechanism unknown, efficacy in infected animals untested, and four of the six compounds were not water-soluble.

evidence.tested: Of 58 synthesized candidates, six killed a drug-resistant A. baumannii strain in the lab, and two of those were not toxic in mice.
evidence.unknown: Four of the six compounds were not water-soluble so were not tested in mice, efficacy in infected animals is untested, and the mechanism is unknown.
evidence.ai_role: A generative model proposed about 25,000 candidate antibiotics and synthesis recipes in under nine hours from over 130,000 building blocks.
